name: The Red Messenger
summary: Executor Arren sends you after a courier bound for the camp outside Deathknell. Dispatched from the Scarlet Monastery, the courier carries word from the crusade to its camp. Intercepting him secures intelligence before the zealots can strengthen their hold in the valley. This is among the Forsaken's first offensive efforts to secure their fledgling sanctuary.

sections.title: Eyes in the East
sections.body: Word of the Scarlet courier reaches Executor Arren through his superiors in Brill. The Scarlet Crusade sent an emissary west from its stronghold at the Scarlet Monastery to Deathknell. Crusaders press across Lordaeron, and a courier sent to the edge of the Forsaken's waking grounds signals an organized effort to destroy the newly risen before they can prepare a defense.

sections.title: Intercepting the Courier
sections.body: Meven Korgal, the courier, blended into the small Scarlet camp east of Deathknell without distinctive heraldry. Executor Arren orders a targeted strike to kill Korgal and seize his dispatch. Taking the missives cuts off the local zealots from further tactical coordination with their eastern headquarters.

sections.title: Vital Dispatches
sections.body: The recovered Scarlet Crusade Documents contain propaganda, scouting notes, and direct orders for the zealots to expand their camp near the ruined capital. They also hold a strategic map marking field commanders and agents throughout the glades. The map is valuable enough to warrant immediate delivery to higher authorities in Brill.

faq.answer: Meven Korgal is a human courier serving the Scarlet Crusade. He was sent from the Scarlet Monastery to carry strategic orders to the zealots near Deathknell.

faq.q: Where did the messenger come from?
faq.answer: The messenger came from the Scarlet Monastery, the Scarlet Crusade's massive fortified headquarters in northeastern Tirisfal Glades.

faq.q: What information was found in the documents?
faq.answer: The dispatches hold scouting summaries, orders to build up Crusader fortifications near Lordaeron's ruined city, and a strategic map showing the positions of Crusade field commanders and agents.

faq.q: Where does this intelligence go next?
faq.answer: Executor Arren immediately forwards the map and gathered intelligence to his superiors in Brill. It gives the wider Forsaken military actionable targets across Tirisfal.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade encroaching so close to Deathknell?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade seeks to eradicate all undead abominations without distinction. Deathknell is where newly freed undead first rise from their graves, making it a target for zealots trying to destroy the Forsaken before they organize.

faq.q: Who gave Executor Arren the tip about the messenger?
faq.answer: Forsaken command in Brill intercepted news of the courier's departure from the monastery and passed it to Arren, so his local forces could intercept him.

angles.text: Intercepting the messenger strikes at zealots who seek to kill you again before you have found your footing in Lordaeron.
As a new Horde recruit, you help break Scarlet operations along the northern perimeter of the Horde's newly established foothold in the Eastern Kingdoms.
As a newly awakened rogue, you take on covert work by infiltrating the Crusade's camp, killing Meven Korgal, and stealing his dispatches.
